summary: Replaces `Integer.valueOf(String, int).intValue()` with `Integer.parseInt(String, int)` to avoid unnecessary boxing/unboxing.
rejectionReason: DUPLICATE: JDT PrimitiveParsingCleanUp (CleanUpConstants.PRIMITIVE_PARSING) already handles Integer.valueOf(String,int).intValue(), with exact radix examples in CleanUpTest.testPrimitiveParsing and boxed-result negatives in testDoNotUsePrimitiveParsing. It additionally handles Long, Short, Byte and applicable implicit-unboxing cases. The proposal adds no material capability.
